title: Electrician Work Safety Glove Alert
problem: Young electrical repair apprentices touch live main switches with bare hands, taking dangerous electric shock risks.
idea: A glove checker. The camera sees the hands and sounds a buzzer if rubber gloves are missing. Tap what the camera sees to try it.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Is the worker safe?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine sees the hands and PictoBlox sounds a buzzer.
widgets.question: Before touching the switch board, the camera sees:

options.label: Rubber gloves on
options.result: Good! Gloves are on. Now check the mains is switched OFF before starting.
options.te: బాగుంది! గ్లోవ్స్ ఉన్నాయి. ముందు మెయిన్ ఆఫ్ చేయండి.

options.label: Bare hands
options.result: BUZZ! STOP! No gloves. Wear insulated rubber gloves first.
options.te: ఆగండి! గ్లోవ్స్ లేవు. ముందు రబ్బరు గ్లోవ్స్ వేసుకోండి.

options.label: Wet hands
options.result: DANGER! Never touch electricity with wet hands. Dry hands and wear gloves.

items.title: Mains OFF
items.text: Always switch off the mains and remove the fuse before work.
items.te: పని ముందు మెయిన్ స్విచ్ ఆఫ్ చేయండి.

items.title: Rubber footwear
items.text: Wear rubber-soled footwear and stand on a dry surface.
items.te: రబ్బరు చెప్పులు వేసుకుని పొడి నేలపై నిలబడండి.

items.title: Never live wires
items.text: Never work on live wires. Use a tester to check power is off.
items.te: కరెంట్ ఉన్న వైర్లపై ఎప్పుడూ పని చేయవద్దు.

items.title: Children stay away
items.text: Electrical work is only for trained adults.

questions.q: What is the FIRST step before electrical repair?
questions.why: Switching off the mains removes the current.

questions.q: If someone gets a shock, you should…
options: Switch off power or push them away with a dry wooden stick
questions.why: Touching them can shock you too. Cut power first, then call 108.

questions.q: Who should do electrical repair work?
questions.why: Electricity can kill. Only trained adults should do this work.

how: Open Teachable Machine and choose Image Project.
Make classes: Gloves on, Bare hands. Take 50 photos of each (just hands, no real wires!).
Train the model, Export and copy the link.
In PictoBlox, add the Machine Learning extension and paste the link.
If class is Bare hands, play a loud buzzer sound and show 'STOP – wear gloves'.
Ask Gemini for electrician safety rules and make a poster for the ITI workshop.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Write 5 short electrical safety rules for young electrician apprentices in simple English and Telugu: switch off mains, rubber gloves, rubber footwear, never touch live wires, use a tester.
